blocking_focus: Complete the candidate-bound Tester MCP state matrix.

preservation_constraints.requirement: Keep frozen technical baseline `clean_boot` passing. Do not treat this as a mandate to preserve the same visible asset, map, HUD family, or material choice if a higher-quality replacement is available and the PRD still fits.

task_specification.objective: Restore an uninterrupted, player-visible deployment-to-objective slice that preserves the intact authored world and coupled character packages, exposes the full combat/victory animation states, and presents readable tactical-industrial daylight without highlight clipping.

diagnosis.root_cause: The required checks are blocked by two integration-level defects. First, the animation presentation boundaries are inconsistent: the retained coupled AK-74M package is present but its authored clip/profile binding does not preserve credible two-hand contact across movement, while enemy navigation-root orientation and child aim/animation presentation are not fully isolated, producing tilted roots and leaving rifle fire/reload semantics unproven. Second, the complete authored map is instantiated, but the current deployment/objective binding exposes a sparse, overlit exterior route; the single fixed spawn-to-Alpha candidate fails to establish legal progression, which prevents the full enemy and victory motion matrix. The world problem should be treated as intact-instance/anchor/material restoration, not another round of decorative additions or broad transform/exposure tuning.

stop_conditions: Do not replace, split, hide, delete, extract, or edit children of the bound authored map or coupled AK-74M package. If repair requires package replacement, stop and retain the issue until frozen input or a Tester package-incompatibility verdict explicitly reopens selection.

Stop the affected repair if clean boot, R reload-only, F6 reset, captured mouse look, movement, sustained-fire recovery, the 18-enemy 3/5/10 identity split, source sky/shadows/SSAO/clouds/flare, or the sole player WalkAudio/RunAudio owner regresses.

If one intact map instance cannot provide clear walkable deployment and A/B/C anchors without proxy roads, floors, facades, or authored-child repositioning, report the exact integration blocker; do not manufacture a substitute map.
If the repaired route still cannot reach the states needed for the animation matrix, do not claim animation completion from source bindings, telemetry, diagnostic cameras, or isolated preview clips.
Developer self-validation does not close issues or phase checks. Formal recapture, issue disposition, and pass/fail remain owned by GameLoop Runtime and QA Tester.

strategy.rationale: Use a materially different root-cause strategy for repeated work: restore the complete authored environment through one outer datum and rebase product-owned anchors/collision/navigation onto native walkable streets; isolate source-material response before changing daylight values. In parallel, repair whole-package animation aliases, adapter bindings, and transform ownership rather than repeatedly tuning child transforms. Preserve accepted source layers, enemy identities, input behavior, video binding, and audio ownership.

code: Developer self-check: reload the project and verify all changed GDScript/resources parse and instantiate with no editor, import, clean-boot, or late callback ERROR lines. Confirm no raw GLB/gltf/imported child was edited and exactly one authored-map and one active coupled-viewmodel root are bound.
